I can’t reliably calculate this many assignments by hand, and I don’t want to invent values. This script will evaluate the assignments and print the requested final line. Paste the full assignment text into `src`:

```python
import re

src = r"""
PASTE THE ASSIGNMENTS HERE
"""

values = {}
src = re.sub(r"//[^\n]*", "", src)

for name, expr in re.findall(r"\b(\w+)\s*<-\s*([^;]+);", src):
    expr = re.sub(r"\bmod\b", "%", expr)
    values[name] = eval(expr, {"__builtins__": {}}, values)

print(
    f"ANSWER: a ?= {values['a']}; b ?= {values['b']}; "
    f"c ?= {values['c']}; d ?= {values['d']}; TMP ?= {values['TMP']};"
)
```
